title: Marguerite and the Asset
author: I. M. Sandoval
blurb: Coral Dunmore, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
